extraction.notes: Q4 2024 (three months ended Dec 31, 2024) column used. FFO subtotal is 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (379,507), after preferred distributions; the separate 'FFO' line of 379,862 was not used as the ffo_total. Reproduced: 433,871 -> 430,402 -> 379,507 -> 392,074 all tie. Per-share check: 379,507/391,195 = $0.97; 392,074/391,195 = $1.00 (matches reported). EQR reports no AFFO. The 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' line (1,141) was classified as 'other' because its underlying assets are not specified as land or securities; it could arguably map to land_sale_gain_loss. 'Debt extinguishment and preferred share redemption (gains) losses' is printed as an em dash for Q4 2024, recorded as 0. Preferred distributions (-355) were classified as 'other' since no preferred-specific category exists. Recurring capex is only disclosed on an annual basis (year ended Dec 31, 2024, 166,507 consolidated), not for the quarter; recorded as basis 'annual'.
